senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (पटति)
To go, to move.
r. 10th cl. (पटयति)
1 To string.
2 To surround or encompass.
3 To share, to portion, to distribute.
(पाटयति)
1 To speak.
2 To shine.
With उत् prefixed,
To pluck up, to eradicate, to destroy utterly.
With वि,
To fly, to run away.

mn. (-टः-टं)
1 Fine cloth.
2 Coloured cloth.
3 A leaf or sheet of cloth, &c. on which any figures may be painted.
m. (-टः)
1 A kind of tree: see पियाल.
2 Any thing well made or polished.
f. (-टी)
1 A particular sort of cloth, coarse thick cloth, canvas.
2 A screen of cloth surrounding a tent, an outer tent.
3 A coloured or chintz garment.
n. (-टं)
A thatch, a roof.
E.
पट to surround, aff. अच् fem. aff. ङीप्: see पटि.

m. (-ट्टः)
1 Cloth.
2 Coloured cloth.
3 Wove silk.
4 A turban, &c. or cloth for that purpose.
5 A coloured silk turban.
6 A fillet bound round the head.
7 A bandage, a ligature, a cloth bound round a sore, &c.
8 An upper or outer garment.
9 A plant, commonly called Pāt, (Corchorus olitorius,) from the fibres of the bark of which, called Jute, a coarse sack-cloth and cordage are prepared.
10 A stone for grinding with a mullar.
11 A plate of metal for inscription or engraving.
12 A royal grant or order written on copper, stone, &c.
13 A shield.
14 A place where four roads meet.
15 A chair, a stool.
n. (-ट्टं)
A city, a town, a village, the Pettah probably of the south.
f. (-ट्टा)
1 An ornament of the forehead.
2 Red Lodh.
3 A horse's girth.
E.
पट to surround, क्त aff. and त changed to ट.

m. (-टः)
Breadth, expanse, extension.
f. (-टा)
Regular or successive order, series, succession.
E.
पट to spread, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A camp, an encampment.
E.
पट to surround, वुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A kind of bird.
f. (-का)
A flag, a banner.
E.
पट to go, आक Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
Cloth, a bandage, &c.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
1 The half of a village.
2 A shore, a bank.
3 Casting dice.
4 A musical instrument.
5 A large span.
5 Expense or loss of capital or stock.
E.
पट to go, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A weaver.
2 A painter.
E.
पट cloth, and कार maker.

f. (-टिः)
A tent.
E.
पट cloth, कुटि a house.

n. (-रं)
Old cloth.
m. (-रः)
A thief.
E.
पटत् imitative sound, and चर going.

m. (-पः)
A tent.
E.
पट cloth, and मण्डप a house.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of cloth.
n. (-यं)
1 A tent, a canvas house.
2 A petticoat.
E.
पट cloth, मयट् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
A heap, a number, a quantity or multitude.
mf. (-लं-ली)
1 A book.
2 A tree.
3 A stalk.
nf. (-लः-ला)
A roof, a thatch.
n. (-लं)
1 A cover, a coat, an enclosing or surrounding skin or membrane.
2 A place, a spot, a circle or district.
3 A mark on the forehead with Sandal wood.
4 A basket.
5 Train, retinue.
6 A coat of the eye.
E.
पट to go, कलच् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Of a pink or pale red colour.
m. (-लः)
1 Pale red, rose colour.
2 Rice ripening in the rains.
f. (-ला)
1 The Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
2 Red Lodh.
3 A name of DURGĀ.
nf. (-लं-ला)
The flower of the Bignonia suave-olens.
E.
पाट extension, and ला to get, aff. ड; also पाटलि.

m. (-न्तः)
The edge of a thatch.
E.
पटल a thatch, and प्रान्त end.

m. (-पः)
A tent.
E.
पट cloth, and वाप what is woven.

m. (-सः)
1 A tent.
2 A petticoat.
3 Perfumed powder.
E.
पट cloth, वास abode, or वास to perfume, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
Perfumed powder.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-श्म)
A tent.
E.
पट, and वेश्मन् a house.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
A kettle-drum.
m. (-हः)
1 A war-drum, or one used in battle.
2 Injury, killing, slaughter.
3 Tumult.
E.
पट imitative sound, हा to quit or make, aff. ड.

f. (-का)
A leech.
E.
पट to go, आलुच् aff., कन् added.

f. (-टिः)
1 A kind of cloth.
2 An aquatick plant: see कुम्भिका.
E.
पट to surround, &c. aff. इन्: see पट and पटी.

f. (-का)
Cloth.
E.
वुन् added to पटी.

f. (-का)
Red Lodh.
E.
पट्टी the same, कन् added: again with आख्या a name; it is read also पट्टिकाख्य, mf. (-ख्यः-ख्या)

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very clever.
E.
पटु and irr. superlative.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very clever or able.
E.
पटु clever, ईयसुन् aff. of the superlative.

n. (-रं)
1 Sandal-wood.
2 A field.
3 Bambu manna.
4 A radish.
5 The belly.
6 A sieve.
7 Height.
8 Khayar.
9 Rheumatism.
m. (-रः)
1 KANDARPA.
2 A cloud.
E.
पट to go, Uṇādi aff. ईरन्.

m. (-रः)
1 A field.
2 A pungent root, a sort of radish.
3 The pith or manna of the bambu.
4 A cloud.
5 A sieve, a cribble.
6 Tin.
7 Disease arising from wind.
8 Sandal.
E.
पट to go, &c. in the causal form, ईरन् aff.

mfn. (-टुः-टुः-ट्वी-टु)
1 Clever, dexterous, skilful.
2 Diligent.
3 Smart, sharp.
4 Hale, healthy.
5 Warm, hot.
6 Blown, expanded.
7 Cruel, ferocious, unmerciful, unfeeling.
8 Harsh, contumelious, (speech, &c.)
9 Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat.
10 Loquacious, talkative.
m. (-टुः)
1 A small kind of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)
2 The leaf of the Trichosanthes.
n. (-टु)
1 Salt.
2 A mushroom.
E.
पाट r. 10th cl. to speak, &c. Uṇādi aff. डु, and the radical vowel short.

m. (-कः)
A sort of gourd.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं)
Not so clever, a little less able, &c.
E.
पटु clever, and कल्प aff. of incompleteness; also in a similar sense पटुदेश्य, and पटुदेशीय.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Of a clever sort, &c.
E.
पटु as above, and जातीय aff. of kind.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Cleverness.
2 Eloquence.
E.
त्व, added to पटु; also with तल्, पटुता.

f. (-र्णी)
A medicinal sort of moon plant.
E.
पटु a sort of gourd, and पर्ण a leaf, fem. aff. ङीष्^1; also पटुपचक (-कं) and पटुपचिका f. (-का)
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161212. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batches 309-312.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Very clever.
E.
पटु, and रूप here implying much.

n. (-जं)
A tent.
E.
पट, and उटज a house.

m. (-लः)
A kind of cucumber, commonly Palwal, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)
n. (-लं)
A sort of cloth, a kind of chintz.
f. (-ली)
A small cucumber, either the same as above, (Trichosanthes dioeca,) or another kind, (Luffa acutangula.)
E.
पट to go, in the causal form, aff. ओलच्; removing malady.

m. (-कः)
An oyster.
E.
पटोल as above, and कन् aff. of resemblance, compared to the shape of the Trichosanthes.

f. (-का)
A small cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca); it is also applied to Luffa acutangula.
E.
कन् with the fem. form added to पटोली.

f. (-का)
1 A title deed, a Paṭṭa, a lease, &c.
2 A written legal opinion.
E.
पट्ट a royal mandate, &c. ओलच् aff., कन् in the fem. form added.

n. (-जं)
A sort of cloth, probably a kind of canvas or sackcloth.
E.
पट्ठ as above, and ज produced; made from Jute.

nf. (-नं-नी)
A city: see पत्तन.

n. (-नं)
Cutting.
E.
पट to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-वी)
A principal queen.
E.
पट्ट a fillet or tiara, देवी a queen.

n. (-नं)
Crowning, binding the head with a fillet or tiara.
E.
पट्ट, and बन्धन binding.

f. (-षी)
A principal queen.
E.
पट्ट a fillet or tiara, and महिषी a queen.

n. (ङ्गं)
A plant used in dying, (Coesalpinia sappan.)
E.
पटृ cloth, and रङ्ग what colours.

n. (-नं)
Sappan wood.
E.
पट्ट cloth, and रञ्जन colouring; also with कन् added पट्टरञ्जनक.

n. (-कः)
A sort of potherb, commonly also Nālita or Lalita, (Corchorus capsularis.)
E.
पटृ Corchorus, and शाक potherb; the leaves resembling those of the Pāt.

f. (-हा)
A principal queen.
E.
पट्ट, and आरोह what mounts.

m. (-ट्टी)
Red Lodh; also पट्टी.

m. (-टी)
A sort of fish described as having many teeth.

m. (-लः)
A plant, (Coesalpinia bonduccella.)

m. (-ध्रः)
A sort of tree, the bark of which is used as an astringent; the red species of the Lodh, (Symplocos racemosa, Rox.)
E.
पट्टी the same plant, लोध्र the Lodh; also with कन् added पट्टिलोध्रक.

m. (-शः)
A sort of weapon, a kind of axe.
E.
पट to go, aff. टिश or टिस; whence it is also read पट्टिस.

ind.
A vocative particle.
E.
पट to go, in the causal form, aff. क्विप्.

m. (-रः)
A thief.
E.
पटच्चर the same, and अण् pleonastick aff.

mf. (-लिः)
Trumpet flower.
m. (-लिः)
Rice ripening in the rains.
E.
पाटल pale red, aff. इन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made red, tinted red, reddened.
E.
पाटल, and इतच् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
The name of a city, supposed to be the ancient Palibothra, and the modern Patna.
E.
पाटलि the trumpet flower, पू to be pure, त्रन् aff.; also with कन् added, पाटलिपुत्रक; it is also said to be named after its founder and sovereign, पाटलिपुत्र being a proper name.

n. (-लं)
A ruby.
E.
पाटल, and उपल a stone.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Clever, sharp, dexterous.
n. (-वं)
1 Cleverness, talent.
2 Health.
3 Eloquence.
E.
पटु clever, &c. aff. अण्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Cunning, crafty, fraudulent.
2 Clever, dexterous.
E.
पटु clever, ठक् aff.

f. (-का)
A small shrub, (Abrus precatorius): see गुञ्जा.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Torn, broken, divided.
E.
पट to divide, in the causal form, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Going, who or what goes.
E.
पठ to go, अच् aff. and the root repeated, form irr.
